idea-plugin.name: CourseMate AI
idea-plugin.description: A Java course assistant for CST3492 Assignment A, Group A, using the official DeepSeek API. Requires the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable. Retrieves local lecture PDF passages and displays verified filenames and PDF page numbers. Clearly labels general-knowledge answers. Ask about selected Java code from the editor context menu without modifying code.

action.description: Prepare a question about selected Java code; click Send in CourseMate AI to submit
